items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: She sang with my band out in Chattano.

ctx.x: And did you know Lola Bell?

A.J. Millard Bell was a blues singer. A.J. Millard, M-hmm. She was real good. She sang with my band out in Chattano. A.J. Millard, M-hmm. A.J. Millard, M-hmm. Just on maybe a week's engagement I brought out there, so I added attraction. A.J. Millard, M-hmm.
